title: NodeStatus
description: Status and metadata for a single node in the CockroachDB cluster, including address, build details, locality, store information, and activity metrics.

started_at.description: Unix nanosecond timestamp when the node process started.

updated_at.description: Unix nanosecond timestamp of the most recent status update.

metrics.description: Map of metric name to value for this node, covering CPU, memory, disk, network, and SQL throughput metrics.

store_statuses.description: Status objects for each store (disk) on this node.

args.description: Command-line arguments the node process was started with.

env.description: Environment variables set in the node process.

activity.description: Per-node activity metrics including bytes sent and received.
